name: Lightspeed Hero (CR 8)
body:
Lightspeed Hero
CR 8

Half-elf samurai 1 (warrior poet)/unchained monk 6/champion 3
NG Medium humanoid (elf, human)/outsider (native)
Init +6 (amazing initiative); Senses low-light vision, Perception +5

DEFENSE

AC 21, touch 21, flat-footed 17 (+3 Dex, +1 dodge, +2 monk, +3 Wis, +2 Cha)
hp 59 (7d10+1+15)
Fort +7, Ref +8, Will +7. +2 racial vs. enchantment spells and effects
Defensive Abilities evasion, hard to kill, purity of body, recuperation, resolve 1/day, still mind; Immune sleep

OFFENSE

Speed 101 ft. (+10 exodus of speed, +20 fast movement, +5 fleet, +6 favored class bonus [elf ], +30 impossible speed)
Melee +1 ki focus katana +11/+6 (1d8+4, 18-20) or unarmed strike +10/+5 (1d10+3)
Ranged masterwork shuriken +11/+6 (1d2+3), earthfire shuriken +11 (1d2+4)
Special Attacks fleet charge, fleet warrior, flurry of blows (+1 attack), ki strike (magic), mythic power 9/day, skirmisher’s challenge 1/day (+1 dodge to AC, +1 insight on saves), stunning fist 7/day (DC 17), style strike (defensive spin) (1/round), surge +1d6

STATISTICS

Str 10, Dex 17, Con 10, Int 10, Wis 16, Cha 14
Base Atk +7, CMB +10, CMD 25
Traits Charming, Enlightened Warrior
Feats Agile Maneuvers, Combat Reflexes, Dodge, Fleet, Mobility, Planar Heritage (aasimar), Psychic Sensitivity, Improved Unarmed Strike, Run, Stunning FistM , Weapon FinesseM
Skills Acrobatics +13/+41/+45, Diplomacy +12/+13, Escape Artist +13, Sense Motive +13
Languages Common, Elven
SQ dual minded, flourish (exodus of speed), ki pool (6 points), ki powers (snatch arrows, sudden speed), mythic ki, order (order of the eastern star)
Gear +1 ki focus katana (8,350 gp), earthfire shurikenP50NoFS (400 gp), monk’s kit (8 gp), monk’s robe (13,000 gp), potion of cure serious wounds (750 gp), quick runner’s shirt (1,000 gp), 5 masterwork shuriken (31 gp)
